P2.finding: Alphabetic streaming emits large optional pytest files before setup/restart/summary and detects 2MB overflow only after partial output, losing 19 files and final manifest. This is an evidence packaging defect; no third CI is authorized.

bundle.basis: Each complete base64/gzip stream decodes without error; all non-cleanup decoded bytes SHA256 equal the full cleanup.sanitized_files map. Cleanup itself is validated from its complete stream and CI source/control flow, not by a self-hash.

tests.exact_scope: Ten original PG-compatible nodes, excluding the SQLite-only read-revoke barrier
tests.runtime_schema_create: Source fixture asserts false in each environment, but this value is not directly stored in recovered fixture receipts

restart.count_gate: Child returns success only if restart_count==1; wrapper raises for nonzero child exit
restart.assertions_covered: same directory pg_ctl fast-stop/status3/start; changed postmaster start time; same runtime user; complete source/cold table snapshots identical; cold authorized record projection/history/data_version==5
restart.limitation: Success supports executed assertions, not independent recovery/recalculation of unavailable restart receipt/snapshots.

setup.app_role_original_flags: Available in ten fixture receipts, all five false
setup.note: Do not substitute Windows runner label, PGBIN directory, source intent, or inferred major version for an actual SQL version string.

cleanup_inference: Receipt lists initial_status, stop, final_status; frozen code records stop only after initial status returned0, checks successful stop, final status3, deletes root and verifies absence before PASS. Thus running-before-stop is source/control-flow supported this time; individual raw pg_ctl stdout remains unavailable.

secret_scan.triaged_false_positives: 12 literal JS ${token} / ${ctx.token} template expressions; concrete Bearer values are synthetic-test-A
secret_scan.scope: Raw CI log and 34 complete decoded files; postgres credential URI, GitHub token, JWT, concrete bearer, add-mask and password assignment patterns
secret_scan.limitation: No access to deleted randomized passwords for exact comparison; this is bounded screening, not an absolute no-secret claim.

minimal_local_report_fix_design: Keep cleanup/redaction/hash gates before any bundle output.

Precompute all candidate hashes, raw sizes, compressed sizes and chunk counts before emitting; select essential core receipts/JUnit/fixture proofs first under the unchanged 2000000-byte compressed cap.
Reserve bounded final manifest/summary space; optional omitted files must appear explicitly as OMITTED with original sanitized SHA256/raw size/compressed size, never pretend full bundle complete.
Do not split a gzip file across inclusion/omission; print complete chosen streams and final manifest plus explicit selection status.
Local synthetic report tests only: oversized optional data, exact hash/byte/chunk checks, explicit omissions, unchanged gate failures. No DB/CI/third trigger.
remaining_conditions: Archive raw log byte-for-byte and all 34 complete decoded files plus missing list and bounded scan.
Fix report packaging locally if desired, marked never executed in Windows CI; it cannot recover deleted/missing originals.
No additional PG run is permitted; full measured version and original restart receipt remain an evidence limitation.
